name: xorgxx/neox-crud-bundle
description: Neox CRUD Bundle: generic factory-based CRUD with handlers, events, Mercure and makers.

suggest.symfony/mercure-bundle: To enable Mercure subscriber for CRUD events
suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: Required to render components() in Twig (dependency of UX LiveComponent)
suggest.symfony/ux-live-component: Optional: enable the opt-in live_table (interactive server-side index table)
suggest.pagerfanta/pagerfanta: Optional: enable the opt-in live_table pagination
suggest.pagerfanta/doctrine-orm-adapter: Optional: enable the opt-in live_table with Doctrine ORM (QueryAdapter)

scripts.test:coverage: @php -d xdebug.mode=coverage -d zend.assertions=1 -d assert.exception=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml.dist --coverage-clover var/coverage.xml --coverage-text
